senses.gloss: [to break through, run, v. פֶּרֶד II]

units: Ukts. II, 6 הרמון שפְּרָדוֹ a pomegranate which one has cut in two (leaving the seeds in their sheathes; Maim.: שפֵּרְדוֹ, Pi., the grains of which one loosened by drying).—Part. pass. פָּרוּד; f. פְּרוּדָה; pl. פְּרוּדִים, פְּרוּדִין; פְּרוּדוֹת.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32a:8">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>אם היה פ׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K01061"><he>כָּפַת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 8:8">Toh. VIII, 8</cite> <he>אוכל פ׳ אינו וכ׳</he> eatables divided into pieces are not counted together (to make up the required size for levitical cleanness).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:9">Ib. IX, 9</cite> <he>נמצא על גבי פ׳</he> (Maim. <he>פֵּירוּדִים</he>) if the creeping thing is found on broken olives.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:9">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ על גבי פ׳</he> pieces on top of pieces; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:1">Succ. III, 1</cite> <he>נִפְרְדוּ עליו</he> if its leaves are spread, opp. to <he>נפרצו</he>.
<cite ref="Horayot 10b:13">Hor. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 18:1">Prov. XVIII, 1</cite>) <he>זה לוט שנ׳ וכ׳</he> that means Lot, who separated himself from Abraham; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:29">Tosef. Shebi. VI, 29</cite> <he>מְפָרְדִין</he> (ed. Zuck. a. oth. <he>מְפָרְרִין</he>), v. <cite ref="Q01574"><he>פֶּרֶד</he> I</cite>. Y. B. Mets. II, 11ᵇ bot. <he>המְפָרֵד בגרוגרות</he> who separates dried figs; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 16:28">Prov. XVI, 28</cite>) <he>שה׳ אלופו של עולם</he> he (the serpent) caused the friend of the world (the Divine Presence) to withdraw; [Matt. K.; estranged the prince of the world (Adam, from God)].
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>מפְרִיד</he> ‘Rashi’; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 801">Yalk. Deut. 801</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q02041"><he>פְּרָת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to separate one’s self; to be scattered.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII, 10</cite> <he>יִתְפָּרְדוּ כמוץ וכ׳</he> let them be scattered like chaff before the wind; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 3:8">Orl. III, 8</cite> <he>נִתְפָּרְדוּ וכ׳</he> if the pomegranates are cut; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:10">Tosef. Ter. V, 10</cite>.
